artifact: FINAL evidence handoff v1 - one goal: protect value and margin while growing sales (discount rules/culture loop)
content_class: sanitized, source-linked; no raw text, no names, no CRM money figures

evidence_classes.verified_external_review: Five owner-approved SubQ Snap 1.1 pair reviews (below) + one earlier SubQ pilot pair on a reviews norm. Verdicts are signals, not proofs.
evidence_classes.verified_quote_gate: Every claim in the private packet passed a code-enforced exact-quote gate against full source texts (span + SHA-256). This verifies provenance, not semantic truth.
evidence_classes.context_reviewed: Demo-ready rules/examples/counterexamples in culture-rules-brief.json: each re-read by the central reviewer with surrounding context (date, subject, amount basis, offer-vs-sale stage).
evidence_classes.candidate_grade: 3,351 merged fan-out claims (Spark drafts, central quote gate, deterministic semantic samples per batch with flagged items annotated/excluded from demo). NOT exhaustively semantic-reviewed; never cite as verified facts or frequencies.
evidence_classes.internal_secondary: Internal analytical summaries and archive digests (e.g. the 45-branch price-scatter episode note; a 2025 paid-with-discount episode surviving only as a 359-char archive summary). Attribution-level only.
evidence_classes.simulated: Synthetic demo pipeline data and rule-preview simulations (including the proposed reciprocity rule preview and any synthetic review packets). Product demonstration, not company evidence.

rules_and_culture_refs.brief: database/fixtures/culture-rules-brief.json (5 reviewed rules, 5 observed examples, 3 counterexamples, claim+source+quote refs inside)
rules_and_culture_refs.discount_packet: database/fixtures/review-packet-subq-discount.json (9 claims, 5 SubQ pairs, mixed per-claim mandate status)

pilot_pair_reviews_norm.label: contradictory
pilot_pair_reviews_norm.framing: possible_conflict signal only, low confidence; different topic (reviews), not a discount comparison

cannot_claim: Prevalence or frequency of discounts/grants/refusals (keyword-selected, claim-capped pool; not a representative sample).
Causality: that price scatter caused a specific lost deal (internal secondary attribution only), or that any norm caused any outcome.
That chat grants became accepted deals or payments (CRM linkage unestablished; the one paid-with-discount episode is archive-summary only).
CRM revenue, totals, or client counts (semantics unverified, frozen).
Comprehensive monitoring of the organization (one concrete goal only).
Retroactive violations of the proposed rule by historical episodes.
That the corpus is fully distilled (3,351 candidate claims over 994 of 7,697 candidate sources; chunk-level bounded slices).
